retained: Positive-base logkf/expkf/xpowf arithmetic; FMA two-F32 helper order and coefficients.
F32 exponent division and per-axis eight-value vector block/scalar-tail schedule from the pinned Torch CPU kernel.
changes: Scalar Rust translation of a single ARM vector lane; no SIMD or Torch dependency.
Explicit finite domain base[1,65536], exponent[0,1]; reject other inputs. Omit unreachable negative, subnormal, NaN, infinity and overflow branches.
Within the admitted domain exp exponent stays[0,16], so general ldexp reduces to a single exact normal power-of-two multiplication.
Apple paired sin/cos uses the public math.h __sincosf through a C pointer-ABI shim. The shim is original glue, not copied SLEEF.
scope: BF16 Metal denoiser RoPE on macOS ARM64 only. Existing table allocation and position bounds remain. CPU/F32 and other platforms retain the previous paths.
